message.content: {"passages":[{"reference":"16","text":"Nevertheless, all of you should know that the bishop toils more than all of you, because each of you suffers his own affliction, but he suffers both his own and that of each person. Therefore, Clement, preside as a helper to each person as far as you are able, bearing the cares of everyone. Hence, in undertaking to have you administer, I know that I have received a favor, not given one. But take courage and endure nobly, knowing that when you reach the harbor of rest, God will repay you with the greatest of good things—an inalienable reward—because, for the salvation of all, you undertook the greater toil. Thus, if many of the brothers hate you because of righteousness carried to the utmost, their hatred will do you no harm, but the friendship of the righteous God will benefit you greatly. Therefore, strive to shake off praise that arises from injustice, but through righteous administration pursue the beneficial praise that comes from Christ.","lexical_decisions":[{"source_quote":"πλεῖον κάμνοντα τὸν ἐπίσκοπον","chosen":"the bishop toils more","rationale":"κάμνω denotes strenuous labor or wearisome exertion here."},{"source_quote":"ἑκάστῳ κατὰ τὸ δυνατὸν προκαθέσθητι βοηθός","chosen":"preside as a helper to each person as far as you are able","rationale":"προκαθέσθητι denotes taking a leading or presiding position, while βοηθός defines that position as one of assistance."},{"source_quote":"τὸ σὲ οἰκονομεῖν ἀναδέξασθαι","chosen":"in undertaking to have you administer","rationale":"The rendering takes σέ as the subject of οἰκονομεῖν and the speaker as the subject of ἀναδέξασθαι."},{"source_quote":"ἀναφαίρετον μισθόν","chosen":"an inalienable reward","rationale":"ἀναφαίρετον describes something that cannot be taken away."},{"source_quote":"τὴν ἐπ’ ἄκρον δικαιοσύνην","chosen":"righteousness carried to the utmost","rationale":"The wording preserves the intensifying image of righteousness extending to the limit."},{"source_quote":"τὸν ἐκ χριστοῦ ἐπωφελῆ θηρεύειν ἔπαινον","chosen":"pursue the beneficial praise that comes from Christ","rationale":"θηρεύειν is literally to hunt or pursue, and ἐπωφελῆ characterizes the praise as beneficial."}],"source_issues":[{"source_quote":"τὸ σὲ οἰκονομεῖν ἀναδέξασθαι","issue":"The nested infinitives permit more than one syntactic construal, especially concerning how Clement’s administration relates to the speaker’s undertaking. The translation understands the speaker to have undertaken the appointment of Clement to administer.","proposed_reading":"","blocks_publication":true},{"source_quote":"πάντων ’σωτηρίας","issue":"The supplied reading contains a raised apostrophe before σωτηρίας where no elision is apparent. This is a confirmed printed feature, not treated as an OCR error, and it does not affect the translated sense.","proposed_reading":"πάντων σωτηρίας","blocks_publication":false}]},{"reference":"17","text":"After saying these things and many more besides, he again looked toward the multitude and said, “And you also, my beloved brothers and fellow servants, yield in every respect to the one presiding over truth, knowing this: the one who grieves him has not received Christ, whose chair has been entrusted to him; and, as one who has not received Christ, he will be reckoned as one who has rejected the Father. Therefore, he will be cast out of the good kingdom. For this reason, strive to attend every assembly, so that you may not, as deserters, incur a charge of sin because of the commander’s discouragement. Therefore, above all else, all of you should be concerned for him, knowing that because of each of you the evil one wages war against him alone with greater hostility. So strive to continue in affection toward him and goodwill toward one another, and to obey him, so that he too may be relieved and you may be able to be saved.”","lexical_decisions":[{"source_quote":"ἀδελφοὶ καὶ σύνδουλοι","chosen":"brothers and fellow servants","rationale":"σύνδουλοι presents them as sharing the status and allegiance expressed by δοῦλος."},{"source_quote":"τῷ προκαθεζομένῳ ἀληθείας","chosen":"the one presiding over truth","rationale":"The genitive with προκαθεζομένῳ identifies that over which the person presides."},{"source_quote":"οὗ τὴν καθέδραν πεπίστευται","chosen":"whose chair has been entrusted to him","rationale":"The passive πεπίστευται presents the presiding figure as entrusted with Christ’s chair."},{"source_quote":"ὡς λειποτάκται","chosen":"as deserters","rationale":"λειποτάκτης is a military term for someone who abandons an assigned rank or post."},{"source_quote":"τοῦ ταξιάρχου ἀθυμίας","chosen":"the commander’s discouragement","rationale":"ταξίαρχος sustains the military image, while ἀθυμία denotes loss of heart or discouragement."},{"source_quote":"αὐτῷ ἐπακούειν","chosen":"to obey him","rationale":"In this exhortatory context, ἐπακούειν means responding submissively rather than merely hearing."}],"source_issues":[{"source_quote":"καὶ ’ὡς χριστὸν","issue":"The supplied reading contains a raised apostrophe before ὡς. This is a confirmed printed feature, not treated as an OCR error; it has no evident syntactic function in the sentence.","proposed_reading":"καὶ ὡς χριστὸν","blocks_publication":false}]},{"reference":"18","text":"But you should also understand some things on your own, because he cannot speak openly on account of the plots. For example, if he is hostile to someone, do not wait for him to say, “Do not associate with this person.” Instead, prudently follow his purpose, becoming enemies of those to whom he is hostile and not associating with those with whom he does not associate, so that each person, claiming to have everyone as friends, may be saved by reconciling him and heeding his instruction. But if anyone remains a friend to those to whom he is hostile and speaks with those with whom he does not associate, he himself is also one of those who want to destroy the church. For although he is with you in body, since he is not with you in purpose, he is against you—far worse than the enemies who appear openly, scattering those within under the guise of friendship.","lexical_decisions":[{"source_quote":"ἐν φανερῷ λέγειν","chosen":"speak openly","rationale":"The phrase means speaking publicly or plainly rather than in concealment."},{"source_quote":"τῷδε μὴ προσαμιλλᾶσθαι","chosen":"Do not associate with this person","rationale":"Although προσαμιλλᾶσθαι can denote engaging or contending with someone, the surrounding references to friendship and social contact support a relational sense here."},{"source_quote":"φρονίμως ἕπεσθε αὐτοῦ τῷ βουλήματι","chosen":"prudently follow his purpose","rationale":"βούλημα denotes the leader’s intention or purpose, which the audience is to discern and follow."},{"source_quote":"ἐπιδικαζόμενος τοῦ πάντας φίλους ἔχειν","chosen":"claiming to have everyone as friends","rationale":"The middle ἐπιδικαζόμενος expresses asserting a claim, though the construction with the articular infinitive is unusual."},{"source_quote":"τῆς αὐτοῦ ἐπακούων ὁμιλίας","chosen":"heeding his instruction","rationale":"ὁμιλία can mean discourse or instruction; that sense fits the requirement to heed the presiding figure."},{"source_quote":"τῷ σώματι συνὼν ὑμῖν, τῇ γνώμῃ μὴ ὢν μεθ᾽ ὑμῶν","chosen":"although he is with you in body, since he is not with you in purpose","rationale":"The rendering preserves the contrast between bodily presence and inward intention."},{"source_quote":"μετὰ δοκούσης φιλίας","chosen":"under the guise of friendship","rationale":"δοκούσης marks the friendship as seeming or apparent rather than genuine."}],"source_issues":[{"source_quote":"αὐτὸν διαλλάττων σώζηται, τῆς αὐτοῦ ἐπακούων ὁμιλίας","issue":"The antecedent and precise function of αὐτόν are not explicit. It most naturally refers to the presiding leader, but it could refer to the alienated person; the following αὐτοῦ likewise depends on an unstated antecedent. The translation preserves the pronominal ambiguity rather than inserting a name.","proposed_reading":"","blocks_publication":true}]},{"reference":"19","text":"After saying these things, there in the midst of everyone, he laid his hands on me and urged me to sit in his own chair. When I had sat down, he immediately said this to me: “Before all my brothers who are here with me, I charge you: whenever I depart from this present life—as is owed to me—send James, the Lord’s brother, a concise written account, including even your reflections from childhood and how, from the beginning until now, you have traveled with me, listening to the words and deeds proclaimed by me from city to city. Then, at the end, do not hesitate also to make known the cause of my death, as I foretold it. For this will not grieve him greatly, since he knows that I have piously discharged what I was in every way bound to suffer. Rather, he will obtain the greatest consolation when he learns that after me the teacher’s chair was entrusted not to an unlearned man ignorant of life-giving words and not knowing the church’s rule. For deceptive discourse destroys the souls of the crowds who listen.”","lexical_decisions":[{"source_quote":"καθεσθῆναί με. ἐδυσώπησεν","chosen":"urged me to sit","rationale":"δυσώπησεν here means that Peter prevailed upon or strongly entreated Clement; the preceding infinitive supplies what he urged him to do despite the intervening printed period."},{"source_quote":"τῶν ἐκ παίδων σου λογισμῶν","chosen":"your reflections from childhood","rationale":"λογισμοί denotes thoughts or reflections, and ἐκ παίδων locates them from childhood onward."},{"source_quote":"τῶν κατὰ πόλιν ὑπ᾽ ἐμοῦ κηρυχθέντων λόγων τε καὶ πράξεων","chosen":"the words and deeds proclaimed by me from city to city","rationale":"The rendering preserves the source’s application of κηρυχθέντων to both λόγων and πράξεων."},{"source_quote":"τὴν τοῦ θανάτου μου πρόφασιν","chosen":"the cause of my death","rationale":"πρόφασις can mean occasion, cause, or pretext; the causal sense best fits the requested account of the death."},{"source_quote":"ὃ πάντως ἔδει με παθεῖν εὐσεβῶς ἀπεδόμην","chosen":"I have piously discharged what I was in every way bound to suffer","rationale":"ἀπεδόμην presents the required suffering as an obligation rendered or discharged."},{"source_quote":"ἐκκλησίας κανόνα","chosen":"the church’s rule","rationale":"κανών denotes an authoritative norm, standard, or rule and need not mean a later fixed collection of texts."},{"source_quote":"πλάνος γὰρ ὁμιλία","chosen":"For deceptive discourse","rationale":"πλάνος characterizes the discourse as misleading, while ὁμιλία here denotes teaching or discourse."}],"source_issues":[{"source_quote":"καθεσθῆναί με. ἐδυσώπησεν","issue":"The printed period separates the infinitive καθεσθῆναί from the finite verb ἐδυσώπησεν that most naturally governs it. This is treated as an editorial punctuation feature, not as an OCR error.","proposed_reading":"καθεσθῆναί με ἐδυσώπησεν","blocks_publication":false},{"source_quote":"ὅπως ὁπόταν τοῦ ἐνταῦθα (ὡς ἐμοὶ ὀφείλεται) ἀπαλλάξω βίου, σὲ Ἰακώβῳ τῷ ἀδελφῷ τοῦ κυρίου διαπέμψαι","issue":"The supplied construction combines ὅπως with an infinitive and contains a second accusative σέ after the initial Ἀξιῶ σε. Read without correction, it could suggest sending Clement himself to James; the subsequent context instead concerns sending a written epitome. The translation follows the likely intended request to send James the written account, but the syntax is unresolved.","proposed_reading":"ὅπως ὁπόταν τοῦ ἐνταῦθα (ὡς ἐμοὶ ὀφείλεται) ἀπαλλάξω βίου, σὺ Ἰακώβῳ τῷ ἀδελφῷ τοῦ κυρίου διαπέμψῃς","blocks_publication":true},{"source_quote":"οὐκ ἀμαθὴς ἀνὴρ καὶ ζωοποιοὺς λόγους ἀγνοῶν","issue":"The scope of οὐκ over the coordinated description is syntactically loose: taken narrowly, it negates only ἀμαθής while leaving the man described as ignorant of life-giving words. The translation takes the negation over the whole disqualifying description, as the consolatory context appears to require.","proposed_reading":"","blocks_publication":true},{"source_quote":"ἐκκλησίας κανόνα. οὐκ εἰδὼς","issue":"The printed period interrupts a participial description that continues into the main verb. This is treated as editorial punctuation rather than missing text.","proposed_reading":"ἐκκλησίας κανόνα οὐκ εἰδὼς","blocks_publication":false}]},{"reference":"20","text":"Therefore I, my lord James, when he had said these things and I had given my promise, did not delay. As I had been commanded, I arranged under headings the greater part of the discourses delivered from city to city, which had already been written to you beforehand and sent by him in books, as a kind of reminder, and in this form sent them to you, giving the work the title “Clement’s Epitome of Peter’s Preachings during His Sojourns.” But I will now begin to set it out as I was commanded.","lexical_decisions":[{"source_quote":"ὑποσχόμενος οὐκ ὤκνησα","chosen":"I had given my promise, did not delay","rationale":"The aorist participle supplies Clement’s promise before οὐκ ὤκνησα states that he did not hesitate or delay to act."},{"source_quote":"τὸ πολὺ τῶν κατὰ πόλιν λόγων","chosen":"the greater part of the discourses delivered from city to city","rationale":"τὸ πολύ denotes the greater part or bulk, while κατὰ πόλιν distributes the discourses by city."},{"source_quote":"ἐπὶ κεφαλαίων ποιῆσαι","chosen":"arranged under headings","rationale":"κεφάλαια are summary headings or principal points used to organize an epitome."},{"source_quote":"ὥσπερ σημείου χάριν","chosen":"as a kind of reminder","rationale":"σημεῖον is a sign or marker; in this context the organized summary functions as an aid to recall."},{"source_quote":"Κλήμεντος τῶν Πέτρου ἐπιδημίων κηρυγμάτων ἐπιτομή","chosen":"Clement’s Epitome of Peter’s Preachings during His Sojourns","rationale":"ἐπιδημίων is taken as describing the preachings associated with Peter’s stays or sojourns in the cities, though it can also carry the broader sense of local or public activity."},{"source_quote":"τοῦ ἐκτιθέναι ὡς ἐκελεύσθην ἄρξομαι","chosen":"I will now begin to set it out as I was commanded","rationale":"ἄρξομαι governs the articular infinitive and marks the transition from the letter to the promised exposition."}],"source_issues":[]}]}
